## Expected and actual behavior

Describe what happened and what you expected. If peers diverge, include both
outputs and the inputs each peer used.

## Reproduction

Include the smallest code, input values, and operation sequence that reproduce
the problem. For pathing, include the map topology, query and traversal medium,
and any publication or overlay steps. For controller behavior, include the fixed
frame sequence and the accepted pose when using the Gravitas adapter.

## Environment

- Package version and standard or Lean profile
- Target framework, runtime, OS, and architecture
- Serialization transport or Gravitas version, if relevant
